description:
Duk-It (McDonald Products Corp.)
Solid American Walnut with Brass Ferrule
Mid-Century Modern, Six-Pipe Capacity
This mid-century pipe rack was produced by McDonald Products Corp. of Buffalo, New York, under their renowned Duk-It line of executive desk accessories and tobacciana. Crafted from genuine American walnut, the stand showcases clean lines and a central tapered pedestal accented with a brass ferrule, reflecting classic mid-century functional design.
Solid American walnut construction with rich natural wood grain throughout
Accommodates up to six smoking pipes with carved base rests and circular top cutouts
Brown felt protective base retains original Duk-It and Genuine American Walnut foil labels
Measures 6 inches long by 6 inches wide and 5.5 inches tall
Condition:
Good vintage condition with solid structural integrity and a stable base. The brass collar retains age-appropriate patina, and the bottom felt and foil maker labels remain intact.

shipping.policy:
Shipping Policy
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Please verify your shipping address prior to placing your order! We are unable to stop, change, or redirect any shipments once the order has been shipped!
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.

description:
Lots are Sold As Is.
This auction is a bulk sale, we are unable to provide additional information on individual items featured in this auction. We are unable to verify count or completeness of large lots. All lots are FINAL SALE. No Refunds or Returns.
About Us / Mission
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties provides vocational and educational opportunities that eliminate barriers to employment, strengthen communities, and help individuals reach their full potential through the power of work.
Thank you for supporting our mission.
Item Condition & Seller Disclosure (Important)
All items are
USED and donated
to Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties.
While items are visually inspected, our staff are
not subject-matter experts
, and some defects, missing parts, or operational issues may go unnoticed. Descriptions represent our observations at the time of listing and should not be considered expert evaluations.
Please review all photos carefully.
Ask any questions
before bidding
.
By placing a bid, buyers acknowledge and accept the item’s condition as described and shown.
Electronics Testing & AS-IS Policy
Some electronic items may not be fully tested due to time constraints, lack of equipment, or item complexity. When an item is
not tested
, this will be clearly disclosed in the listing description.
Important terms:
Electronics are sold
AS-IS
unless otherwise stated.
Only the testing explicitly described in the listing has been performed.
If no testing details are mentioned,
no testing should be assumed
.
Power cords, adapters, batteries, manuals, or accessories are
not included unless specifically stated
.
Un-tested or partially tested electronics are
not eligible for refunds
.
Shipping Policy
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.
Local Pickup Policy
All items are available for local pickup.
Scheduling & Payment
Pickup appointments are
required
and must be scheduled through the Pickup Scheduler on ShopGoodwill or in the app.
All orders must be paid in full prior to pickup.
No payments are accepted at the time of pickup.
Pickup Hours
Monday–Saturday:
8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
Closed for lunch:
11:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Please arrive on time. If delayed, notify us through a customer service ticket.
Items must be picked up within
14 calendar days of payment
. Items not collected within this period are considered
abandoned & re-donated
and are relisted
without refund
.
Buyers may arrange third-party pickup or delivery for large or “Pickup Only” items. The carrier must be able to pack, load, and transport the item and assumes full responsibility. Please submit a customer service ticket for coordination.
No pets allowed
, except service animals.
Pickup Location
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties
Goodwill Outlet
1401 N. Rice Ave
Oxnard, CA 93030
(Entrance on Maulhardt — Check in with the Outlet Cashier)
Returns & Refunds
All items are sold
AS-IS
and are
non-refundable
, except in cases of:
Damage occurring during shipment, or
Gross misrepresentation.
All returns require
prior approval
.
Requests must be submitted within
5 days of delivery
via the customer service ticketing system.
Shipping-damage claims must include clear photos of both the item
and
original packaging.
Returns will be denied if the item has been altered, tampered with, or modified after shipment.
Authenticated Items
If this auction has been authenticated by a third-party vendor, the Title or Description may state w/COA or Authenticated however it Does NOT come with physical COA.
COA is only emailed upon request.
Items authenticated by third-party providers include a
$9.99 handling fee
.
Customer Service
Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
For assistance, submit a customer service ticket through your account or use the
Contact Seller
link on the listing.
We aim to respond within
2 business days
. Closure of a ticket indicates a response has been issued and does not necessarily indicate final resolution.

description:
Collection of Rough Rock Salt Mineral Specimens Natural Pink Hues 2.6 lbs
This listing includes a collection of rough rock salt mineral specimens, often mistaken for rose quartz due to their pink hues. The stones are unpolished and vary in size and shape, exhibiting natural pink colors with occasional white and reddish-brown inclusions. The material is translucent with a crystalline structure. Some pieces show surface imperfections or mineral deposits typical of raw rock salt. These specimens are in their natural, unprocessed condition and are suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, crafts, décor, or metaphysical uses. Lot weighs approximately 2.6 lbs
6 x 5 x 5 in

Lot of 24 Loose Gemstone Packets
A vintage collection of 24 individually packaged loose stones from Lindenwold's Fine Jewelers, manufactured in the United States. Dating to the late 20th century, these stones were distributed for custom mounting, jewelry making, and collecting. The collection includes a wide assortment of clear faceted round stones alongside colored faceted stones and cabochons sealed in their original manufacturer packaging.
Includes 24 sealed packets marked Lindenwold's Fine Jewelers
Primarily clear faceted round-cut stones in various graduated sizes

Packaged with 22 black card backs and 2 white card backs, each with hanging tab

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Art Glass Cullet Chunk
Cobalt Blue with Rainbow Iridescent Finish
Decorative Glass Specimen, 1.365 Pounds
Substantial decorative chunk of cobalt blue cullet slag glass displaying a vibrant iridescent carnival-style flash across fractured planes and smooth surfaces. Raw glass chunks like this were produced during the glassmaking process at heritage American glassworks, where excess furnace glass cooled into monolithic blocks before being fractured into decorative specimens prized for garden displays, lapidary projects, and paperweights.
Intense translucent cobalt blue glass body with rich color depth
Exterior exhibits strong rainbow iridescence in vivid hues of gold, magenta, and turquoise
Natural conchoidal fracturing showcasing glass cleavage, smooth waves, and raw crystalline textures
Measures approximately 4 inches by 2.25 inches by 3.25 inches; weighs 1.365 pounds
Condition:
Formed as a raw fractured glass chunk with natural sharp edges, conchoidal ridges, and cleavage faces inherent to slag glass. Clean surfaces with brilliant luster and no post-manufacture cloudiness or chemical damage.

description:
A complete 87-piece service for 12 in Noritake Ivory China’s Parkridge pattern (No. 7561). Each piece has a warm ivory body and a graceful border of sage green scrolls and leafy sprigs with clusters of tiny white flowers. A fine platinum band sits inside the border, and a platinum trim finishes every rim. The set includes dinner plates, salad plates, bread and butter plates, rimmed soup bowls, fruit or dessert bowls, teacups with saucers, a creamer, an open sugar bowl, and a gravy boat with an attached underplate. It would suit holiday dinners and formal entertaining, a wedding or anniversary table, or replacing pieces in a Parkridge collection.
Details:
Style: Fine ivory china dinnerware with scrolling floral border and platinum trim
Color: Ivory with sage green, gray, and white floral accents; platinum trim
Pieces: 12 dinner plates, 12 salad plates, 12 bread and butter plates, 12 rimmed soup bowls, 12 fruit or dessert bowls, 12 teacups, 12 saucers, 1 creamer, 1 open sugar bowl, and 1 gravy boat with attached underplate (87 pieces)
Size: Salad plates about 8.5 in diameter; soup bowls about 7.5 in diameter and about 1.75 in tall; bread plates about 6.5 in; saucers about 6 in; fruit bowls about 5.5 in diameter and about 1.5 in tall; teacups about 3.75 in across and about 2.5 in tall; gravy boat about 8.5 in long and about 3.5 in tall
Marks: Backstamp reads “Noritake Ivory China, Japan, 7561, Parkridge” with the laurel wreath “N” logo
Condition:
The pieces shown are intact, and the floral borders are crisp with good color throughout. The platinum rims and inner bands are bright on most pieces. Some backstamps are faded or partly worn, mainly on a few plates and saucers. The inside of the gravy boat has a few small dark specks and faint gray marks. A few fruit bowls have small dark specks in the well, and one has a tan stain on the underside near the foot ring. The plates show light utensil marks in the centers, visible in raking light. Foam sheets separate the stacked pieces. Please review all photos. Sold as shown.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This collection includes various rock and mineral display kits featuring polished agate slices, labeled tumbled stones, identified metamorphic rock samples, Moh's Hardness Scale mineral specimens, and assorted stones from a Scholastic kit.

Specifications:
- Framed polished agate slice in wood shadow box
- Natural Gemstones display with labeled tumbled stones
- GeoCentral Metamorphic Rock Science Kit with identified samples
- Moh's Hardness Scale set with labeled mineral specimens
- Rocks on the Go Scholastic kit with assorted stones

All components include visible labels and are assembled as display sets.

description:
You are purchasing a "Polished Singular Stone Slice Mineral Bookend Preowned" in "Used" condition.
Striking polished stone slice with a flat base that stands beautifully on its own, perfect as a display piece, paperweight, or unique home decor accent. One side features a rough, natural outer surface, while the cut and polished faces reveal dramatic internal crystal structure with subtle banding and color variation. This piece has an organic, earthy look with a translucent interior that catches the light and highlights the natural patterns. It works well on a desk, shelf, or in a mineral and crystal collection, adding texture and visual interest to any space. Approximate visible size reference is shown with a tape measure in the photos to help you gauge height and width. shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.
